theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let a length-$n$ original array $f$ with values bounded by $U$ precede allocation base $b$. Take positive band size $g$, positive moduli $p,m$, shift bounded by $D$, and valid band index $i$. Under the stated placement, residue-scratch, word, and depth bounds, one band step constructs the exact histogram, physical buckets, and six-cell pointer record for band $i$, preserving all protected cells except that record and its allowed band workspace.

This band step retains the original-index histogram and bucket data once for reuse across many wanted queries.
